passkeyGuide.title: Passkeys
passkeyGuide.intro: Passkeys let admins sign in with Touch ID, Windows Hello, or a security key instead of a password. The two settings below tie a passkey to this exact site — get them wrong and passkeys will fail to register or sign in.
passkeyGuide.rpIdBody: The domain the dashboard is served from, without a protocol or port — for example example.com.
passkeyGuide.originBody: The exact URL the dashboard loads from, protocol included — for example https://example.com.

telegramGuide.title: Telegram OAuth2
telegramGuide.intro: Setting up "Sign in with Telegram" requires a Telegram bot, and that bot needs some extra configuration for the feature to work correctly.
botSetupSteps: Open the Mini App via the "Open" button
Select your bot and press Bot Settings
If a domain is already set under Web Login, remove it
Press Switch to OpenID Connect Login. If that button isn't there, go back a menu after removing the domain and repeat step 3
Press Add an Allowed URL and enter the values below:
telegramGuide.accessSetupIntro: After filling in the Client ID and Client secret, you need to list the admin IDs allowed to sign in.
accessSetupSteps: From the account you want to grant access, message @Get_myidrobot
The bot replies with your ID -- enter it into the corresponding field
telegramGuide.knownIssuesIntro: Protections layered in front of the panel (cookie policies and similar) can misbehave with Telegram OAuth2.
telegramGuide.knownIssuesProxyTip: Use the /oauth2/ path in your reverse proxy to work around this.
telegramGuide.errorBotDomainBody: This happens when the bot's domain isn't configured correctly -- revisit "Setting up the bot" above and redo it step by step if needed.
telegramGuide.errorNoCodeTitle: Error: no confirmation code arrives from Telegram at login
telegramGuide.errorNoCodeBody: This isn't something fixable on Remnashop's side. Try a bot created a while ago, or a different browser. You can also try signing in on one of Telegram's own "official" surfaces first, e.g. fragment.com -- since the Telegram session is shared within the browser, that can help the panel sign-in go through.

githubGuide.title: OAuth2: GitHub
githubGuide.createAppIntro: First, create an OAuth app. Follow this link to create one:
githubGuide.callbackIntro: Under Authorization callback URL, enter your panel's address.
githubGuide.callbackCommentLabel: Replace YOUR_REMNASHOP_DOMAIN with your panel's address
githubGuide.callbackNote: Don't forget to replace YOUR_REMNASHOP_DOMAIN with your panel's actual address.
githubGuide.settingsBody: Once the OAuth app is created, copy the Client ID and Client secret. Paste them into the corresponding fields.

oidcGuide.title: OpenID Connect (SSO)
oidcGuide.intro: Any OIDC-compliant provider works — Keycloak, Authentik, Zitadel, Auth0, PocketID, and others. The issuer must serve the standard /.well-known/openid-configuration endpoint.
oidcGuide.callbackTitle: Creating the app with your provider
oidcGuide.callbackIntro: When creating the app with your OIDC provider, set the Redirect URI below.
oidcGuide.callbackCommentLabel: Replace YOUR_REMNASHOP_DOMAIN with your panel's domain
oidcGuide.callbackNote: Don't forget to replace YOUR_REMNASHOP_DOMAIN with your actual panel domain.
oidcGuide.settingsBody: Enter your provider's Issuer URL along with the Client ID and Client secret you received. The display name is used as the label on the login button.
